item.title: NEWS Announces Yokohama Arena Concert on Oct 7 2026
item.description:
NEWS Announces Yokohama Arena Concert on Oct 7 2026

NEWS will perform at Yokohama Arena in Yokohama on Wednesday, October 7 2026. The concert is part of the 25th Anniversary Trilogy “We Are NEWS Live Tour 2026 /// KMK”.

📍 Venue & Date

  • Date: Wednesday, October 7 2026
  • Venue: Yokohama Arena, Yokohama
  • Tour: ’25th ANNIVERSARY TRILOGY WE ARE NEWS LIVE TOUR 2026 /// KMK’

🎟️ Ticket Information

  • Official ticket sales are managed through the event’s official website (link provided on the source site).
  • Overseas ticket sales, if any, will be announced on the official website.
  • Tickets may also be available on the secondary market (resellers).
  • Note: Purchasing tickets may require a Japanese phone number for receipt.
  • Guidance on obtaining a Japanese SIM card as a non‑resident is referenced.

⚠️ Important Notices

  • This site is not the official event website.
  • Information is subject to change and may contain inaccuracies.
  • Events may be cancelled, schedules altered, or requirements changed without notice.
  • For the latest details, check the official site.
  • Errors can be reported to contact@japanconcerttickets.com.

📢 Disclaimer

  • Our site is reader‑supported.
  • When you buy or book through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission at no extra cost to you.

Source: NEWS in Yokohama, 2026-10-07 - Tickets & Event Details
